## Public contribution summary

Describe the user-facing contract, documentation or SDK change.

## Publication checklist
- [ ] All content is my own or appropriately licensed for public Apache-2.0 distribution.
- [ ] No confidential/private code, business secrets, credentials or real customer data.
- [ ] No internal architecture diagrams, private source snippets, unpublished inventions or sensitive customer metadata.
- [ ] Changes follow open-source license requirements and preserve third-party attribution.
- [ ] No statements claiming trademark clearance, official affiliation or security certification.
- [ ] Tests or example validations (using synthetic data) are documented.

Contributors cannot grant private-platform rights by modifying a public repository. Never share secrets in PR descriptions or CI logs.
